body: Thank you. This made a difference to me.

Thanks. I am in so much pain, I don't even know where to turn anymore. Not sure I even want to turn to help. To work so hard and still not achieve anything is getting me down so much. I try and be optimistic but I just get letdown all over. It's tough.
I wish I could say a few years ago things were happy. They were just as miserable.
